exposure: Oral antibiotics (amoxicillin) given to sows around parturition
Simple microbiota association in postnatal phase
Complex microbiota association in postnatal phase
outcome: Distribution of OR51E1 along the GIT
Relation of OR51E1 with endocrine markers (chromogranin A, serotonin, peptide YY)
cohort: The study included young pigs, specifically piglets reared from sows receiving or not receiving oral antibiotics around parturition, and caesarean-derived piglets orally associated with simple or complex microbiota.
finding: The olfactory receptor OR51E1 is an enteroendocrine marker in the pig gastrointestinal tract, and its gene expression is significantly affected by age, pathogen challenge, and manipulations influencing the gastrointestinal luminal microenvironment.
